name: reliohub-link
description: Construction company operations in ChatGPT through the RelioHub MCP server.

interface.longDescription:
RelioHub Link connects ChatGPT to your construction company's RelioHub account. Ask about your projects and their schedules, workers, hours and timesheets, daily reports, job photos, to-dos, company rules and library documents, quotes, invoices, payment records and expenses, and take everyday actions such as clocking in, writing a daily report, logging an expense or drafting a quote.

What you can see and do follows your RelioHub role and the access profile your company granted you (read, field or manage). Workers see their own time and expenses and the projects they are assigned to. Quotes, invoices and payments are available only to admins and supervisors. ChatGPT asks you to confirm before it sends a quote or invoice to a client or does something that can't be undone.

Requirements: a RelioHub user account (company ID and username), and MCP access granted by your company admin or supervisor. Your company's RelioHub account must include AI assistant access. RelioHub Link does not sell anything in ChatGPT and does not charge cards or move money. It records payments your company receives and can return the link to an invoice's RelioHub pay page.

RelioHub is published by Northmark Management Group, LLC. Help: https://reliohub.com/support
capabilities: Daily reports, job photos and to-dos
defaultPrompt: Show the projects I can access.
Summarize my hours for last week.

positive.description: List the projects the signed-in user can access
positive.prompt: Show the projects I can access in RelioHub.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the three projects of the review company: Maple Street Kitchen Remodel and Cedar Park Office Buildout (both Active), and RelioHub Review, the company's own internal project.

positive.description: Summarize the user's own hours for a fixed week
positive.prompt: How many hours did I work from September 28 to October 4, 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the signed-in user's five timesheets on Cedar Park Office Buildout, 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM each weekday from September 28 to October 2, 2026, and reports 42.5 hours in total. It does not count the other worker's timesheets.

positive.prompt: What are our company safety rules?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the four rules under Safety as written: hard hat, safety glasses and steel-toe boots on every active site; fall protection at 6 feet or more; lockout/tagout before electrical work; report every injury or near miss the same day. It does not invent other rules.

positive.prompt: What's on the schedule for the Maple Street Kitchen Remodel?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the project's four tasks with their dates: Demolition (Oct 5-7, 2026), Rough plumbing (Oct 8-12), Cabinet install (Oct 13-16) and Final inspection (Oct 19).

positive.prompt: Show me quote Q-1000: who is it for, what's the total, and has the client signed it?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that Q-1000 is for Jordan Ellis on the Maple Street Kitchen Remodel, has three lines (cabinets, quartz countertop, install labor), totals $18,955.78 including 8.25% tax on taxable lines, is open (sent, awaiting the client) and has not been signed yet.

negative.description: Travel booking is not a RelioHub feature
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Austin to Miami next Friday.

negative.description: RelioHub cannot move money from a bank account
negative.prompt: Send $500 from our bank account to our lumber supplier.

negative.description: RelioHub does not post to social media
negative.prompt: Post our latest job photo to the company's Instagram account.

review.commerce_description: RelioHub Link sells nothing in ChatGPT: no subscriptions, credits or digital goods, and it does not process card payments or move money. A contractor can use it to create quotes and invoices for the contractor's own customers, record payments the contractor received, and get the link to an invoice's RelioHub pay page, where that customer pays the contractor outside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First public release of RelioHub Link. Connects ChatGPT to a RelioHub company account through the RelioHub MCP server with OAuth sign-in. Tools cover projects and schedules, workers and hours, daily reports, photos, to-dos, company rules and library, quotes, invoices, payment records and expenses, filtered by role and access profile. Every tool states its read-only, destructive and open-world behavior.

es-ES.subtitle: Operaciones de construcción
es-ES.description:
RelioHub Link conecta ChatGPT con la cuenta de RelioHub de tu empresa de construcción. Pregunta por tus proyectos y sus cronogramas, trabajadores, horas y hojas de tiempo, reportes diarios, fotos de obra, tareas, reglas y biblioteca de la empresa, cotizaciones, facturas, pagos registrados y gastos, y realiza acciones del día a día como marcar entrada, escribir un reporte diario, registrar un gasto o preparar una cotización.

Lo que puedes ver y hacer depende de tu rol en RelioHub y del perfil de acceso que te dio tu empresa (lectura, campo o gestión). Los trabajadores ven su propio tiempo y sus gastos, y los proyectos a los que están asignados. Las cotizaciones, facturas y pagos solo están disponibles para administradores y supervisores. ChatGPT te pide confirmación antes de enviar una cotización o factura a un cliente o de hacer algo que no se puede deshacer.

Requisitos: una cuenta de usuario de RelioHub (ID de empresa y usuario) y acceso MCP otorgado por el administrador o supervisor de tu empresa. La cuenta de RelioHub de tu empresa debe incluir el acceso a asistentes de IA. RelioHub Link no vende nada en ChatGPT y no cobra tarjetas ni mueve dinero. Registra los pagos que recibe tu empresa y puede darte el enlace a la página de pago de RelioHub de una factura.

RelioHub es publicado por Northmark Management Group, LLC. Ayuda: https://reliohub.com/support
